description: Energy Injected into the Distribution Network is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This Dataset represents the origin of the energy that is injected into the Distribution network. The Dataset is composed of the following elements: PRE - Production originating from producers under a special regime specifications by production technology. The data is obtained through production information from producers with guaranteed tariff (PRE) by technology. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy, Renewables. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
